name: Shenzhen
summary: Shenzhen is China's technological mecca: from a fishing village to a megacity of skyscrapers in four decades, today it is home to the headquarters of Tencent, Huawei and DJI, as well as the world's largest electronics market in Huaqiangbei. The cost of living is remarkably low for a world-class city, although the big obstacle for the remote nomad is the Great Firewall: Google, WhatsApp, Instagram and Gmail are blocked, so you need a reliable VPN installed before entering the country.
